ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of high-intensity yellowish-white pixels (approx. 70%) contrasted against low-intensity black/dark-brown pigments localized along the trailing edges and in focal circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the entire trailing edge. High-intensity white patch at the lateral tip of the left lobe. Distribution of approximately 18-22 low-intensity circular 'bullseye' blobs across the medial and central fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels. Extremity of the right lobe shows significant jaggedness with deep, non-uniform valleys compared to the smoother leading edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave posterior curve characterized by a sharp upward and outward sweep towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of numerous dark-ringed circular clusters (rosettes) distributed semi-randomly; largest clusters located in the lower-central region of the left lobe and mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, low-contrast vertical white linear marks detected on the lower ventral surface of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serrations and jagged tissue profile along the trailing edge of the right lobe, suggesting previous physical trauma or significant wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellow/ochre biostaining across the primary high-intensity ventral regions, distinct from the white fluke pigmentation.
